title: Storage
description: Create reusable destinations for database and volume backups.
editDescription: Credentials stay protected. Leave the field blank to keep the current secret.
name: Name
credentialsHint: Credentials are encrypted and are never displayed here.
credentialsKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the existing credentials.
credentialsRequired: Enter both credential fields, or leave both blank.
emptyBody: Connect Amazon S3, Azure, Cloudflare R2 and more, or start with this server's disk.
deleteDescription: This destination will no longer be available to backup configurations.
deleteUsedDescription: This destination is used by {{count}} backups. Remove it from those configurations before deleting it.
backupDestinationHint: Choose a destination created in workspace Storage.
noDestinations: Create a destination in Storage first.

toasts.tested: Destination works: test file written, read and deleted

chooseProviderDescription: Choose where backups go. Ploydok fills in the endpoint and checks the destination for you.
awsEndpointHint: Endpoint chosen by AWS from the region.
accountInvalid: Enter a valid identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
secretKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
connectionStringHint: Optional. Paste it from Access keys in the Azure portal to fill in the fields below.
connectionStringInvalid: This connection string has no AccountName or AccountKey.
createBucket: Create the bucket if it does not exist
createContainer: Create the container if it does not exist
createBucketHint: Ploydok then writes, reads and deletes a test file to prove the destination works.
endpointOverrideHint: Only for a jurisdiction, a private endpoint or an emulator. Leave empty to use the default.
localHint: Backups stay on this server. If the server is lost, they are lost with it: use it to get started, then add an off-site destination.

reasons.auth_failed: The provider rejected the keys. Check them and their permissions on this bucket.
reasons.bucket_not_found: The bucket does not exist. Create it, or test again with automatic creation.
reasons.endpoint_unreachable: The endpoint cannot be reached from this server. Check the URL, DNS and firewall.
reasons.endpoint_blocked: This endpoint uses a blocked network address.
reasons.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
reasons.unknown: The provider returned an unexpected error.

aws.name: Amazon S3
aws.tagline: The global default object store. Pick the bucket region; the endpoint is set for you.

cloudflare-r2.name: Cloudflare R2
cloudflare-r2.tagline: Paste your account ID and an R2 API token. No egress fees for restores.
cloudflare-r2.accountHint: Shown on the R2 overview page of the Cloudflare dashboard.

azure-blob.name: Azure Blob Storage
azure-blob.tagline: Connects natively to Azure Blob Storage. Paste the connection string from the portal, or the account name and key.
azure-blob.accountHint: The name of the storage account, without .blob.core.windows.net.

gcs.name: Google Cloud Storage
gcs.tagline: Uses Cloud Storage interoperability: create an HMAC key for a service account.

backblaze-b2.name: Backblaze B2
backblaze-b2.tagline: Use an application key restricted to the bucket.

wasabi.name: Wasabi
wasabi.tagline: Pick the bucket region; the endpoint is set for you.

digitalocean-spaces.name: DigitalOcean Spaces
digitalocean-spaces.tagline: Pick the Spaces region and use a Spaces access key.

hetzner.name: Hetzner Object Storage
hetzner.tagline: Pick the location and use S3 credentials from the Hetzner Cloud console.

scaleway.name: Scaleway Object Storage
scaleway.tagline: Pick the region and use an API key from Scaleway IAM.

ovhcloud.name: OVHcloud Object Storage
ovhcloud.tagline: Pick the region and use S3 credentials from your Public Cloud project.

minio.name: MinIO / Garage
minio.tagline: Point to your own S3 server. Keep it on another machine than this one.
minio.endpointHint: URL of the S3 API, including the port.

s3-compatible.name: Other S3-compatible
s3-compatible.tagline: Any S3-compatible service: IDrive e2, Linode, Storj, Exoscale, Ceph...
s3-compatible.endpointHint: S3 API URL given by your provider.

local.name: This server's disk
local.tagline: Backups are written to this server's disk.
